mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT00022.retrieveAttContractOrg */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS CODE ,ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG_MASTER ORG_M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG_M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(ORG_M.org_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(ORG_M.org_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) ORDER BY ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL

SELECT /* LGVATT00022.retrieveAttContractOrgLineWorkerList */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS CODE ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_MASTER M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND M.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND M.flsa_yn = 'N' AND M.fse_yn = 'N'
SELECT /* LGVATT00022."retrieveEmployeeName" */ M.FULL_NAME_LOCAL AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM EMP_MASTER M WHERE M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER=#{employeeNo}

SELECT EM.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER CODE ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER NAME ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_unit_requestor( #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,#{orgId} ) AS org_get_arm_info FROM EMP_MASTER EM WHERE EM.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgId} AND EM.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND EM.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND EM.flsa_yn = 'N' AND EM.fse_yn = 'N' ORDER BY EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER

WITH TurnoverCalc AS (
SELECT CASE WHEN (NVL(SUM(active_flag), 0) + NVL(SUM(resign_flag), 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((NVL(SUM(resign_flag), 0) / (NVL(SUM(active_flag), 0) + NVL(SUM(resign_flag), 0))) * 100, 2) END AS TURNOVER_RATE FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN DATE_HIRE_LGE <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 'YYYYMM')) AND (DATE_RETIRE IS NULL OR DATE_RETIRE > LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_flag, CASE WHEN DATE_RETIRE >= TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 'YYYYMM') AND DATE_RETIRE <= LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 'YYYYMM')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS resign_flag FROM emp_master WHERE organization_id IN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_ID FROM ORG_MASTER START WITH ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgName} CONNECT BY PRIOR ORGANIZATION_ID = PARENT_ORG_ID ) ) ), AttendanceCalc AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(DECODE(b.time_and_attendance_code, 'NW', 1, 'PH', 1, 0)) - SUM(CASE WHEN (r.time_and_attendance_code = 'NN' and b.time_and_attendance_code IN ('NW', 'PH')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN (c.paid_days > 0 OR c.attendance_days > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(DECODE(r.time_attend_detail_code, 'UL_SW', 1, 0)) + SUM(DECODE(r.time_attend_detail_code, 'US_CHB', 1, 0))) / (SUM(DECODE(b.time_and_attendance_code, 'NW', 1, 'PH', 1, 0)) - SUM(CASE WHEN (r.time_and_attendance_code = 'NN' and b.time_and_attendance_code IN ('NW', 'PH')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) END AS ATTENDANCE_RATE FROM tb_att_result_n r JOIN tb_att_code_c c ON r.time_and_attendance_code = c.time_and_attendance_code JOIN tb_att_base_bas_n b ON r.shift_type_code = b.shift_type_code AND r.time_and_attendance_date = b.time_and_attendance_date JOIN emp_master em ON em.employee_number = r.employee_no WHERE r.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm} AND em.organization_id IN ( SELECT ORGANIZATION_ID FROM ORG_MASTER START WITH ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgName} CONNECT BY PRIOR ORGANIZATION_ID = PARENT_ORG_ID ) ), PointMapping AS ( SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */ UPPER(udtc.user_column_name) AS kpi_type, TO_NUMBER(udtr.lower_limit_critical_value) AS lower_limit, TO_NUMBER(udtr.upper_limit_critical_value) AS upper_limit, TO_NUMBER(udtv.table_cell_value) AS point_value FROM tb_pay_user_dfin_table_m udt JOIN tb_pay_user_dfin_table_col_n udtc ON udtc.table_seq_no = udt.table_seq_no JOIN tb_pay_user_dfin_table_row_n udtr ON udtr.table_seq_no = udt.table_seq_no JOIN tb_pay_user_dfin_table_value_n udtv ON udtv.column_seq_no = udtc.column_seq_no AND udtv.row_no = udtr.row_no WHERE udt.table_name IN ('RESIGNATION_RATE', 'ATTENDANCE_RATE') AND udtc.user_column_name IN ('RESIGNATION_RATE', 'ATTENDANCE_RATE') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN udtr.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND udtr.effective_end_yyyymmdd AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN udtv.effective_start_yyyymmdd AND udtv.effective_end_yyyymmdd ), KPI_Base AS ( SELECT KOS.*,
CASE WHEN UPPER(KOS.ITEM_NAME) = 'RESIGNATION RATE' THEN TO_CHAR(TR.TURNOVER_RATE) WHEN UPPER(KOS.ITEM_NAME) = 'ATTENDANCE RATE' THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(AC.ATTENDANCE_RATE * 100, 2)) ELSE TO_CHAR(KOS.ACTUAL_TARGET) END AS DYNAMIC_ACTUAL_TARGET_STR,
CASE WHEN UPPER(KOS.ITEM_NAME) = 'RESIGNATION RATE' THEN TR.TURNOVER_RATE WHEN UPPER(KOS.ITEM_NAME) = 'ATTENDANCE RATE' THEN ROUND(AC.ATTENDANCE_RATE * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS DYNAMIC_ACTUAL_TARGET_NUM
FROM TB_PAY_KPI_OS_STANDARD KOS CROSS JOIN TurnoverCalc TR CROSS JOIN AttendanceCalc AC WHERE 1 = 1 ) select /* LGVATT00022.retrieveKpiOsStandard */ NVL(#{orgName}, '') AS ORGANIZATION_ID , (SELECT ORG_NAME_LOCAL FROM ORG_MASTER WHERE ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgName}) AS ORG_NAME , NVL(#{vendorCode}, '') AS VENDOR_CODE , (SELECT VENDOR_NAME FROM TB_VENDOR_MASTER WHERE VENDOR_CODE = #{vendorCode}) AS VENDOR_NAME , NVL(#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, '') AS TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_YYYYMM , KB.ITEM_NO , KB.ITEM_NAME , KB.PERFECT_TARGET , KB.PERFECT_POINT , KB.DYNAMIC_ACTUAL_TARGET_STR AS ACTUAL_TARGET , CASE WHEN UPPER(KB.ITEM_NAME) IN ('RESIGNATION RATE', 'ATTENDANCE RATE') THEN PM.point_value ELSE TO_NUMBER(KB.ACTUAL_POINT) END AS ACTUAL_POINT
, KB.CRITERIA FROM KPI_Base KB LEFT JOIN PointMapping PM ON UPPER(KB.ITEM_NAME) IN ('RESIGNATION RATE', 'ATTENDANCE RATE') AND PM.kpi_type = REPLACE(UPPER(KB.ITEM_NAME), ' ', '_') AND KB.DYNAMIC_ACTUAL_TARGET_NUM BETWEEN PM.lower_limit AND PM.upper_limit
ORDER BY KB.ITEM_NO

SELECT /* LGVATT00022.retrieveVendorList */ vm.vendor_code AS code /* 근태년월 */ , vm.vendor_name AS name /* 근태년월 */ , to_char(vm.effective_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_date , to_char(vm.effective_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date FROM tb_vendor_master vm WHERE 1 = 1 AND trunc(sysdate) between vm.effective_start_date and nvl(vm.effective_end_date, trunc(sysdate)) ORDER BY vm.vendor_code DESC

SELECT /* LGVATT00022.retrieveRequestDocBaseInfo */ cc.code_data1_value AS arm_no , cc.parent_common_code AS request_code /* LGCOM 결재의 문서유형코드LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE와 매핑 */ FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'ATT0009' /* 사무직 수정요청서 결재요청 */

SUPERVISOR = EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AND PRIOR GRADE NOT IN ('G10', 'G09', 'E16', 'E19') ) SELECT /* LGVATT20551.retrieveARMInfoWithHRPartLD */ sv.application_user_id AS employee_id, sv.user_name AS
